name: SPY SMA-12-month momentum regime filter (x-bookmark scan, rank 1)
hypothesis: Holding SPY only while price is above the 12-month SMA (monthly regime filter) captures most of the index return with materially lower drawdown than buy-and-hold.

rules.entry: Long when price closes above the 12-month SMA at the monthly bar.
rules.exit: Flat when price closes below the 12-month SMA.
rules.position_sizing: All-in/out monthly in the scan model.
rules.risk_limits: None in scan model; JARVIS gates apply.
rules.fees_and_slippage_model: Gross in scan; monthly turnover implies minimal cost drag.

known_failure_modes: Monthly 21.9% Monte Carlo 95th drawdown exceeds the 6.0% JARVIS floor even though the filter reduces absolute DD
The mc_95th_dd floor is sized for JARVIS's low-drawdown paper targets, not equity-index regime filters — a candidate floor-calibration question for the gate policy, not a strategy defect
